You are writing the current research update for AI Macro.

Use only the findings and recent developments in the supplied briefing. Decide what matters, connect related evidence when the relationship is supported, and explain it in clear, natural English for an intelligent general reader. Prioritize significance over coverage. It is fine for the evidence to be mixed. Do not force unrelated facts into one story.

The style reference shows the desired level of restraint, specificity, and sentence construction. Match those qualities without copying its wording. Write like a careful human analyst. Use concrete subjects and verbs. Avoid rhetorical gimmicks and artificial-sounding transitions. Do not mention the prompt, the briefing, evidence IDs, validation, methodology, or the writing process.

On a normal update, candidate_domains identifies sections that may deserve replacement. Update only the domain Reads for which you can write something materially more useful than the prior publication; you may return no domain Reads when none deserves replacement. On a bootstrap publication, write every candidate domain because no prior Read exists. Always write one new Macro Read that explains the most important current story across the platform in two to four coherent paragraphs.

Do not inventory every supplied metric or news item. Use a number only when it helps the reader understand magnitude. Use recent developments when they materially sharpen the interpretation of the measured findings. Treat news reports as reported developments, not as proof of a broader causal claim.

Attach only the fact_ids and event_ids that actually support each passage. Those IDs are citations for the application and must never appear in the prose. Do not invent numbers, facts, events, causes, or forecasts.

Return only the structured response.

compute.analysis: Semiconductor and electronic-component output grew 19.9%, roughly three times the 6.5% rate for computer and peripheral equipment. Yet semiconductor capacity utilization was 76.5%, below the 81.3% rate for computer equipment. The industry aggregates therefore show much stronger semiconductor production growth without higher overall utilization. Reuters separately reported that Chinese AI firms were rushing to secure Nvidia chip capacity amid concern about U.S. curbs, showing why access to specific advanced chips may differ from broad manufacturing conditions.

macro.analysis: The supply-side expansion remains substantial, but pipeline totals need qualification. Semiconductor and electronic-component output grew 19.9%, and available project records show 1,556 data-center sites in development, equal to roughly half the 3,068 operating sites. The power pipeline is less certain: 2,061 GW sits in the active interconnection queue, but only 24.2% has reached executed-agreement or construction stages. Historically, just 13% of the 2000–2020 queue cohort reached operation, so the queue represents potential capacity rather than capacity that can be assumed to arrive. Capital-market support has strengthened. The share of covered companies with positive one-year returns increased to 66.2%, and the median return rose materially to 11.7%; the AI Equity Index and sector trading pressure also edged higher. Funding measures are more mixed. Operating cash flow covers current CapEx at 1.23 times, but cash reserves equal 0.85 years of spending at that rate, while borrower strain of 30.2 remains above lender strain of 19.0. The figures show current cash generation above CapEx, less than a year of CapEx held in reserves, and more pressure on borrowers than lenders. Business deployment remains narrower than individual exposure, although the measures cover different forms of use. Current AI use is reported by 24.6% of businesses and 28.6% expect to use it within six months, while 60.8% of adults ages 18–64 report some generative-AI use. A new enterprise study also reported adoption outpacing AI assurance, pointing to implementation quality as a separate issue from adoption rates. Labor gains are similarly concentrated: only two tracked channels have positive employment growth and two have positive real-earnings growth, with semiconductor manufacturing strongest on employment at 2.0%. Large supply investment and improved market performance therefore coexist with partial business deployment and narrow labor gains.

water.analysis: The broad county-level drought screen improved materially: 261 campuses, or 17.5% of those with county data, are in counties containing some D2-or-worse drought area. The more concentrated screen moved in the opposite direction. The count in counties where at least one-quarter of the area is D2 or worse rose slightly to 193 campuses, or 13.0%. Fewer campuses are now touched by any qualifying county drought area, but more sit in counties with a substantial affected area. These measures describe county conditions, not campus water use or site-specific availability.
